items.title: Barcelona sign Rodri from Man City in £65m deal
items.summary: Barcelona sign Spain midfielder Rodri, the player of the 2026 World Cup, from Manchester City after a trophy-laden seven years with the Premier League club.

items.title: Maguire: I want to be greedy about winning trophies
items.summary: Sitting down with Harry Maguire for one of his first interviews of the season, I found a player who was reflective but also excited about the future and what's to come.

items.title: New Celtic signings unlikely before LASK tie - O'Neill
items.summary: Celtic manager Martin O'Neill does not anticipate any new arrivals before Wednesday's Champions League play-off first leg at home to LASK and insists he would be happy for Reo Hatate to stay.

items.title: Celtic out to erase Kairat pain as O'Neill eyes Champions League return
items.summary: Twelve months ago, Celtic's humiliating Champions League exit to Kairat Almaty set the tone for a campaign of chaos. Martin O'Neill is determined to erase that pain.

items.title: PL chief Masters: Man City charges verdict 'has taken longer than expected'
items.summary: Premier League chief executive Richard Masters says a verdict on the alleged charges against Manchester City "has taken longer than expected".

items.title: Premier League chief Masters says Fifa self-destructed over World Cup plan
items.summary: Premier League chief executive Richard Masters has criticised Fifa president Gianni Infantino's World Cup sell-off plan, saying the organisation has "pressed the self-destruct button" by delivering "a self-inflicted wound".
